::: {#hero-heading}

I'm a PhD student in Quantitative Finance at the Swiss Finance Institute, EPFL. My research sits between ML, optimization, and finance -- I enjoy both building new methods and digging into empirical questions in these areas.

Get in touch by [sending me an email](mailto:andrea.ruglioni@epfl.ch) {{< fa feather-pointed >}}

:::
